body:
Natural gas prices around $3.11 per MMBtu on 6 October 2026, cooler US weather forecasts, and higher LNG export demand set the backdrop for EQT (EQT) following fresh guidance and contract news.

EQT shares at $52.47 have climbed 7.34% over the past week, following a softer 1 month share price return of 4.89% and a year to date share price return that is down 1.85%, while total shareholder return over 5 years is up 184.14%. This suggests long term holders have still seen strong compounding even as near term momentum has only recently picked up.

Scan for other gas producers that could react to the same pricing and volume tailwinds as EQT by reviewing the hand picked 27 high quality undervalued stocks.

EQT has already rewarded long term holders, yet the latest rally only partly closes the gap to various value markers. How much of the potential is still on the table rather than already in the rear view mirror?

Most Popular Narrative: 22% Undervalued

EQT’s most followed valuation storyline points to a fair value of $67.50, which sits well above the recent $52.47 close and anchors on long term contract visibility, midstream volumes, and free cash flow durability.

The ramp-up of large-scale, long-term natural gas supply contracts to new AI data centers and power generation facilities in Appalachia beginning in 2027 and 2028 remains central to EQT capturing growing in-basin demand for its production. This can support more visible revenue and free cash flow from both upstream and midstream operations.

See why 73 investors see EQT as 22% undervalued.

Result: Fair Value of $67.50 (UNDERVALUED)

Still, the EQT story can be knocked off course if decarbonization policies accelerate faster than expected, or if regulatory scrutiny after environmental incidents tightens materially.
